## Builders FirstSource Hosts 2026 Investor Day


November 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/867695273/files/doc_news/Builders-FirstSource-Hosts-2026-Investor-Day-2026.pdf)


IRVING, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Builders FirstSource, Inc. (NYSE: BLDR) (“Builders FirstSource” or the “Company”) is hosting its 2026 Investor Day and webcast today at the New York Stock Exchange. Presentations begin at 8:45 a.m. Eastern Time and are expected to conclude at approximately 12:00 p.m.


Chief Executive Officer Peter Jackson, Chief Financial Officer Pete Beckmann, and members of the senior leadership team will present a detailed overview of the Company’s growth strategy, operational, digital and technology initiatives, capital allocation framework, and long-term financial targets. The event will also include two Q&A sessions with senior leadership.


The live webcast and presentation materials will be available to the public on the Company’s investor relations website at[investors.bldr.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bldr.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54639876&newsitemid=20261117512707&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.bldr.com&index=1&md5=ab358b61388d00ba3cd2fba3c356664b) under the Events and Presentations section. An archived replay will be available within 24 hours following the event’s conclusion and will remain accessible for approximately 90 days.


**About Builders FirstSource**


Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR), headquartered in Irving, Texas, is a leading provider of building materials for professional builders in new residential construction and repair and remodeling. We deliver integrated homebuilding solutions by manufacturing, supplying, and installing a full range of structural and related building products. With approximately 575 locations across 43 states, we serve 48 of the top 50 and 91 of the top 100 Core Based Statistical Areas (CBSAs), ensuring broad geographic coverage and enhancing our ability to partner with our customers. Our leading network of strategically located manufacturing facilities produces factory-built roof and floor trusses, wall panels, vinyl windows, custom millwork and trim, manufactured and semi-custom modular homes, as well as engineered wood that we design and cut specifically for each home. We also assemble interior and exterior doors into pre-hung units for easy installation. Additionally, we distribute a wide range of building products, including lumber, sheet goods, windows, doors, millwork, and specialty items. Our services, which vary by market, include professional installation, turnkey framing, and shell construction. Supported by the latest construction innovations and digital solutions, we help drive greater efficiency across homebuilding. Learn more at[www.bldr.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bldr.com&esheet=54639876&newsitemid=20261117512707&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bldr.com&index=2&md5=17744ccc43593a7b5b11fa6699f99b4d) .
